_comment: The origin this site is served from, plus the wording its metadata uses. scripts/build-site.mjs reads this file and stamps absolute URLs into the staged pages - canonical, og:url and og:image are written relative in the source and absolute in dist - because crawlers read those tags without running script.js. Moving to a custom domain is therefore one edit here, one in sitemap.xml and one in robots.txt; claims.json checks the three against each other so they cannot drift.
